FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Military Backend Changes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Handful of changes to the military backend for submod support.

patchNoteLines.li: Add RaidWeightRegistry and associated interface, for submods to influence the raid weighting for Empire settlements
Add UnitOverlayRegistry and associated interface, for submods to add information to the military squad screen
Add MercenaryDeathEvent, for submods to potentially intercept mercenary deaths

additionalNotes.li: Please raise any issues you find on the Github page.
